stop_condition: All seven brief items adjudicated against measured evidence from the shipped artifact, with the scope judgement ruled on explicitly; no finding at or above high remains in the new refusal condition, its recovery path, the denylist exemption, or the untouched change_set_reconstructed guard.

findings.evidence: PROBE E (isolated git fixture, shipped script): tracker holds the same two files under an alias spelling of the project root. `impact-report.sh --relativized-changed-files` resolves them to src/e1.ts and src/e2.ts, so change_set_hash DOES cover the declared work; the cross-check nonetheless reports `declared=2 bound=2 matched=0` and approve exits 2 with completion_files_total_miss. Grepping the refusal text for spelling|symlink|worktree returns 0 matches. Mechanism: the cross-check norm (qa-gate.sh:3643, ltrimstr($root+"/")) is strictly weaker than impact-report.sh's git-aware, sibling-worktree-safe relativize_for_impact() (:223); the report stores raw tracker spelling in .files[].file while the hash is computed over relativized paths.
findings.description: The amendment justifies promoting matched=0 by asserting that "reason 1's spelling-mismatch concern presumes some shared member survives normalisation". That premise is false: a divergence in the ROOT PREFIX breaks every member simultaneously, which is exactly how matched=0 arises — so reason 1 is dismissed using a premise the mechanism contradicts. Consequence: a correctly and completely bound change set is refused and told its tracker was swallowed, while the pre-existing xnote at :6975 that names this exact cause is now unreachable whenever survivors>0 (the refusal exits first). NOT BLOCKING: the named recovery demonstrably rescues it (PROBE D: rc=2 -> rm baseline + reconcile-tracker + impact-report -> approved, cross-check PASSED), no bypass is needed and nothing false is certified. Remedy (non-bypass): compare against the relativized list, or restore the spelling/worktree cause to the refusal text when bound>0.

findings.evidence: PROBE M (narrowing mutation of the shipped script, diff shown and `bash -n` clean): condition narrowed to `matched==0 && bound==0`. CASE 1 (Q5L6-1's exact shape, declared=3 bound=0): shipped rc=2, mutant rc=2 — identical. CASE 2 (declared=2 bound=1): shipped rc=2 completion_files_total_miss, mutant rc=0 APPROVES. Q5L6-1 and Q5L6-3 both assert `bound=0` in their arithmetic strings; Q5L6-2 has declared=0 and never enters the branch. Therefore all 20 shipped Q5L6 assertions pass under the narrowed variant.
findings.description: The deliberate widening — refusing on matched=0 regardless of bound, which the implementer explicitly flagged for QA to rule on — has no regression control. I RULE THE WIDENING CORRECT (see the approval summary), which makes pinning it the natural closeout: a future editor narrowing to bound==0, the most likely 'simplification' since the task description is written around the bound=0 case, would turn the gate green with no assertion noticing. This is NOT a pairing-requirement violation: the check itself is fully paired on all four legs. Remedy: one assertion with bound>0 and matched=0 expecting rc=2.

findings.evidence: Measured on /bin/bash 3.2.57(1)-release (arm64-apple-darwin25), the only bash on this host: `re=""; [[ "abc" =~ $re ]]` returns rc=2 (not a match), both quoted and unquoted. The guard's own behaviour is correct and fail-CLOSED either way — measured: with WORKFLOW_DENYLIST_REGEX unset, survivors=2 over a 2-path list, so the refusal FIRES rather than being disarmed.
findings.description: The guard comment states that "bash's `=~` treats an EMPTY pattern as matching every string", which is not what the platform bash does. Comment accuracy only — no behavioural impact, and the guard is the right shape regardless. Flagged because this file's headers are explicitly relied on by future editors.
